disposition_reason: Table 3 prints mean, SD, minimum and maximum lead and cadmium in 40 raw milk samples.

study.design: cross-sectional sampling of raw milk at milking
study.origin: livestock area of the Mantaro valley, central highlands of Peru, 92 km from a large mining-metallurgical complex; pastures irrigated with canal water carrying mining discharges
study.market: not purchased (sampled at milking; area production sold in Lima markets)
study.method: dry ashing at 450 C, nitric/hydrochloric acid and hydrogen peroxide digestion, flame AAS (AOAC 973.35)
study.qa: standard solutions for precision; analyzed at an accredited laboratory; no CRM recovery reported
